Using the files in Orca

3MF opens in Orca as one object with every part already on its filament, so you just slice and print. Load your filaments to match: for the Tiny Orbit ornaments that is 1 white/cream, 2 green, 3 red, 4 gold. A single-file tag uses filament 1 for the tag and your chosen filament for the name.
